definitions.explanation: Holding people, typically foreign nationals or soldiers, against their will for a long period, especially by a state in wartime. In Japan it calls to mind the シベリア{抑留|よくりゅう}: the detention of Japanese soldiers and civilians in Soviet labour camps after World War II.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シベリア⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抑留|よくりゅう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was interned in Siberia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漁船|ぎょせん}→漁船：22594_gyosen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗組員|のりくみいん}→乗組員：21154_norikumiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抑留|よくりゅう}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The crew of a fishing boat is being detained by a foreign country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日本兵|にほんへい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{抑留|よくりゅう}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飢|う}え→飢え：19826_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{働|はたら}かされた。
examples.english: After the war, many Japanese soldiers were interned for years and forced to work in cold and hunger.

notes:
Usually passive: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抑留|よくりゅう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be detained in or by ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シベリア{抑留|よくりゅう}: the Siberian internment
- {抑留者|よくりゅうしゃ}: an internee, a detainee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勾留|こうりゅう}: detention of a suspect or defendant during criminal proceedings
- ⟦{拘留|こうりゅう}→拘留：21416_kouryuu⟧: a short custodial sentence (1 to 29 days) under criminal law
- ⟦{捕虜|ほりょ}→捕虜：20662_horyo⟧: a prisoner of war
